annotations.text:
Drab by default, bright once.

Everything is warm grey, zero radius, hairline borders. The only saturated colour in the product is the Random button — so the eye lands on the one control that ends the deliberation. Hover shifts one step darker over 110ms: no lift, no shadow, no scale.

The red timer sits top-right on every screen.

"Time you've spent deliberating : x minutes" — counts from page load, ticks by itself, resets only on refresh. It is live on these artboards, so leave one open a minute and watch it move.
Alternate, not a second direction: identical system, dark ground. Worth a look since this app gets used at night. Say the word and it becomes the default.

One thing to confirm: you said the Random button should be bright "on the login". I read that as Random being the single bright element wherever it appears, landing screen included. If you meant bright ONLY on the signed-out screen and drab on Home, that's a one-line change.
